<?php
/**
 * Token-based API authentication middleware
 * Implements HMAC-SHA256 with timing-safe comparison
 */
class ApiAuthenticator {
    private $db;
    private $secretKey;
    private $tokenLifetime = 3600;
    
    public function __construct(PDO $db, string $secretKey) {
        $this->db = $db;
        $this->secretKey = $secretKey;
    }
    
    /**
     * Generate a new API token for authenticated user
     */
    public function generateToken(int $userId): string {
        $timestamp = time();
        $nonce = bin2hex(random_bytes(16));
        $payload = sprintf('%d:%d:%s', $userId, $timestamp, $nonce);
        $signature = hash_hmac('sha256', $payload, $this->secretKey);
        $token = base64_encode($payload . ':' . $signature);
        
        // Store token hash in database
        $tokenHash = hash('sha256', $token);
        $stmt = $this->db->prepare(
            'INSERT INTO api_tokens (user_id, token_hash, expires_at) VALUES (:uid, :hash, :exp)'
        );
        $stmt->execute([
            ':uid' => $userId,
            ':hash' => $tokenHash,
            ':exp' => date('Y-m-d H:i:s', $timestamp + $this->tokenLifetime)
        ]);
        
        return $token;
    }
    
    /**
     * Validate an incoming API request token
     * Returns user_id if valid, null otherwise
     */
    public function validateToken(string $token): ?int {
        $decoded = base64_decode($token, true);
        if ($decoded === false) {
            return null;
        }
        
        $parts = explode(':', $decoded);
        if (count($parts) !== 4) {
            return null;
        }
        
        list($userId, $timestamp, $nonce, $signature) = $parts;
        
        // Validate format
        if (!ctype_digit($userId) || !ctype_digit($timestamp)) {
            return null;
        }
        
        // Check expiration
        $tokenAge = time() - intval($timestamp);
        if ($tokenAge > $this->tokenLifetime || $tokenAge < 0) {
            return null;
        }
        
        // Verify signature
        $payload = sprintf('%s:%s:%s', $userId, $timestamp, $nonce);
        $expectedSig = hash_hmac('sha256', $payload, $this->secretKey);
        
        if (!hash_equals($expectedSig, $signature)) {
            return null;
        }
        
        // Verify token exists in database and not revoked
        $tokenHash = hash('sha256', $token);
        $stmt = $this->db->prepare(
            'SELECT user_id, revoked FROM api_tokens WHERE token_hash = :hash AND expires_at > NOW()'
        );
        $stmt->execute([':hash' => $tokenHash]);
        $row = $stmt->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
        
        if (!$row || $row['revoked']) {
            return null;
        }
        
        return intval($userId);
    }
}

/**
 * Rate limiter using sliding window algorithm
 */
class RateLimiter {
    private $db;
    private $maxRequests;
    private $windowSeconds;
    
    public function __construct(PDO $db, int $maxRequests = 100, int $windowSeconds = 60) {
        $this->db = $db;
        $this->maxRequests = $maxRequests;
        $this->windowSeconds = $windowSeconds;
    }
    
    public function isAllowed(int $userId): bool {
        $windowStart = date('Y-m-d H:i:s', time() - $this->windowSeconds);
        
        $stmt = $this->db->prepare(
            'SELECT COUNT(*) as cnt FROM api_requests WHERE user_id = :uid AND created_at > :start'
        );
        $stmt->execute([':uid' => $userId, ':start' => $windowStart]);
        $count = $stmt->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC)['cnt'];
        
        return $count < $this->maxRequests;
    }
    
    public function recordRequest(int $userId): void {
        $stmt = $this->db->prepare(
            'INSERT INTO api_requests (user_id, created_at) VALUES (:uid, NOW())'
        );
        $stmt->execute([':uid' => $userId]);
    }
}

/**
 * Access control for API resources
 */
class ResourceAuthorizer {
    private $db;
    
    public function __construct(PDO $db) {
        $this->db = $db;
    }
    
    /**
     * Check if user can access a specific resource
     * Resources have an owner and optional shared_with list
     */
    public function canAccess(int $userId, string $resourceId): bool {
        // Sanitize resourceId - must be alphanumeric
        if (!preg_match('/^[a-zA-Z0-9_-]+$/', $resourceId)) {
            return false;
        }
        
        $stmt = $this->db->prepare(
            'SELECT owner_id, visibility FROM resources WHERE resource_id = :rid'
        );
        $stmt->execute([':rid' => $resourceId]);
        $resource = $stmt->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
        
        if (!$resource) {
            return false;
        }
        
        // Public resources accessible to all authenticated users
        if ($resource['visibility'] === 'public') {
            return true;
        }
        
        // Owner always has access
        if ($resource['owner_id'] == $userId) {
            return true;
        }
        
        // Check shared access
        $stmt = $this->db->prepare(
            'SELECT 1 FROM resource_shares WHERE resource_id = :rid AND shared_with = :uid AND revoked = 0'
        );
        $stmt->execute([':rid' => $resourceId, ':uid' => $userId]);
        
        return $stmt->fetch() !== false;
    }
    
    /**
     * Check if user has admin privileges on a resource
     */
    public function isResourceAdmin(int $userId, string $resourceId): bool {
        if (!preg_match('/^[a-zA-Z0-9_-]+$/', $resourceId)) {
            return false;
        }
        
        $stmt = $this->db->prepare(
            'SELECT owner_id FROM resources WHERE resource_id = :rid'
        );
        $stmt->execute([':rid' => $resourceId]);
        $resource = $stmt->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
        
        if (!$resource) {
            return false;
        }
        
        // Only owner is admin
        return $resource['owner_id'] == $userId;
    }
}

/**
 * Main API request handler
 */
class ApiHandler {
    private $auth;
    private $limiter;
    private $authorizer;
    
    public function __construct(
        ApiAuthenticator $auth,
        RateLimiter $limiter,
        ResourceAuthorizer $authorizer
    ) {
        $this->auth = $auth;
        $this->limiter = $limiter;
        $this->authorizer = $authorizer;
    }
    
    public function handleRequest(array $request): array {
        // Extract token from Authorization header
        $authHeader = $request['headers']['Authorization'] ?? '';
        if (!preg_match('/^Bearer\s+(.+)$/', $authHeader, $matches)) {
            return ['status' => 401, 'error' => 'Missing or invalid Authorization header'];
        }
        
        $token = $matches[1];
        $userId = $this->auth->validateToken($token);
        
        if ($userId === null) {
            return ['status' => 401, 'error' => 'Invalid or expired token'];
        }
        
        // Rate limiting
        if (!$this->limiter->isAllowed($userId)) {
            return ['status' => 429, 'error' => 'Rate limit exceeded'];
        }
        $this->limiter->recordRequest($userId);
        
        // Route request
        $method = $request['method'] ?? 'GET';
        $resourceId = $request['resource_id'] ?? null;
        
        if ($resourceId === null) {
            return ['status' => 400, 'error' => 'Missing resource_id'];
        }
        
        switch ($method) {
            case 'GET':
                return $this->handleGet($userId, $resourceId);
            case 'DELETE':
                return $this->handleDelete($userId, $resourceId);
            default:
                return ['status' => 405, 'error' => 'Method not allowed'];
        }
    }
    
    private function handleGet(int $userId, string $resourceId): array {
        if (!$this->authorizer->canAccess($userId, $resourceId)) {
            return ['status' => 403, 'error' => 'Access denied'];
        }
        return ['status' => 200, 'data' => ['resource_id' => $resourceId]];
    }
    
    private function handleDelete(int $userId, string $resourceId): array {
        if (!$this->authorizer->isResourceAdmin($userId, $resourceId)) {
            return ['status' => 403, 'error' => 'Admin access required'];
        }
        return ['status' => 200, 'data' => ['deleted' => $resourceId]];
    }
}
